displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that some human choices may be genuinely free when an integrated agent rationally settles among live alternatives for reasons without antecedent conditions uniquely necessitating the settlement.

novelty.explanation: This retains the transcript’s alternatives-and-reasons account while adding an explicit integrated-agent relation that repairs the unexplained-control gap.

premises.text: A libertarian claim need establish only that genuinely available alternatives occur in some suitably reflective decisions, not that every action, impulse, impairment, or habit is free.

novelty.explanation: This develops Huemer’s explicitly limited thesis and his distinction between ordinary decisions and impaired cases.

premises.text: An agent can be biologically and environmentally embedded while retaining control unless those influences are shown to uniquely necessitate which supported alternative becomes actual.

novelty.explanation: This combines the influence-versus-determination distinction with the claim that explanation need not entail necessitation.

premises.text: Reasons may guide a selection without necessitating it when the choice expresses the agent’s evaluative perspective, remains intelligible, and is settled through the agent’s deliberative activity.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the transcript’s explanatory stopping point by specifying guidance, expression, and deliberative settlement as control conditions.

premises.text: The appearance of such control supplies defeasible evidence when coherently integrated with deliberation, but its weight must vary with impairment, manipulation, predictive success, and contrary mechanistic evidence.

novelty.explanation: This preserves appearance-based justification while repairing its overly broad reliability rule through explicit defeaters and variable evidential weight.

premises.text: Even if genuine control sometimes exists, responsibility should track the quality of alternatives, understanding, coercion, impairment, and reasons-responsiveness rather than license unrestricted retribution.

novelty.explanation: This narrows the responsibility claim and answers the con side’s humane concerns without abandoning desert-sensitive distinctions.

conclusion.text: Accordingly, pervasive causal influence does not by itself eliminate the possibility that some reflective choices are reason-guided settlements attributable to agents and capable of grounding carefully limited responsibility.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion integrates the strongest pro moves while limiting both the metaphysical frequency and moral consequences of freedom.

newArguments.title: Contrastive intervention test
newArguments.text: A useful empirical program would compare decisions under matched reasons while experimentally varying coercion, cognitive impairment, attentional disruption, and opportunities for reflective reconsideration. If agent-level deliberative capacities systematically explain contrastive differences beyond coarse antecedent predictors, that would not prove libertarian freedom, but it would identify the precise control phenomenon requiring explanation. The pro case could then avoid relying entirely on undifferentiated intuition and instead argue that a successful theory must preserve the causal and normative significance of integrated reflective agency.

novelty.explanation: This is a new empirical strategy for operationalizing agent-level control and does not restate any locked transcript move.

newArguments.title: The authorship luck filter
newArguments.text: The strongest libertarian model should impose a luck filter: an undetermined outcome counts as free only when it issues from stable evaluative commitments, competent awareness, reasons that favor the act, and a deliberative mechanism owned by the person. Mere neural noise or quantum variation would fail these conditions. This framework directly answers the randomness objection by making indeterminacy necessary at most, never sufficient, and locating authorship in the structured relation among agent, reasons, capacities, and settlement.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the pro stopping-point account by incorporating the con objection that indeterminacy alone cannot constitute agency.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that human conduct arises through causally continuous biological and environmental processes, so responsibility should regulate behavior humanely without presuming ultimate self-origination or basic retributive desert.

novelty.explanation: This preserves causal continuity and humane revision while avoiding the transcript’s insufficiently supported universal dismissal of every meaningful control concept.

premises.text: Every observed decision depends upon neural states and capacities shaped by physiology, development, learning, social context, inherited traits, and immediate environmental inputs.

novelty.explanation: This develops the transcript’s multiscale dependence account without treating dependence alone as a completed proof of determination.

premises.text: When relevant antecedent conditions change through learning, treatment, incentives, trauma, fatigue, or altered information, behavior predictably changes through the same causally embedded organism.

novelty.explanation: This expands the mechanistic-change reply into an intervention-based account of behavioral responsiveness.

premises.text: Libertarian sourcehood requires more than reasons-responsiveness because the agent’s evaluative character, weighing process, and capacity to settle are themselves products of conditions the agent did not ultimately choose.

novelty.explanation: This supplies the missing bridge from causal history to the denial of ultimate self-origination while directly addressing reasons-based agency.

premises.text: Introducing an undetermined selection does not create authorship unless a further account explains how the person controls that variation, and any such account must avoid merely relocating prior causation.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens the transcript’s randomness objection by targeting control over variation rather than invoking quantum indeterminacy alone.

premises.text: Protection, rehabilitation, deterrence, restitution, and moral communication can remain justified as causal interventions, while proportionality and rights forbid sacrificing innocent people for aggregate behavioral effects.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the con responsibility framework by answering the framing case through rights and institutional constraints rather than basic desert.

conclusion.text: Accordingly, the evidence supports rejecting ultimate self-created authorship and basic retributive desert while retaining bounded, rights-respecting practices that causally protect people and improve future conduct.

novelty.explanation: This draws a proportionate practical conclusion without claiming that causation eliminates every possible ordinary or compatibilist notion of control.

newArguments.title: The sourcehood regress
newArguments.text: Suppose a reflective agent settles a choice by endorsing one reason over another. The con case can ask what explains the evaluative standards, attention, memory, emotional weighting, and deliberative capacity producing that endorsement. If those features arise from prior biology and experience, the settlement lacks ultimate self-origination; if they arise without explanation, their unexplained occurrence adds no ownership. This regress does not show that deliberation is unreal, but it challenges the stronger claim that deliberation makes an agent the ultimate source required for basic desert.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a structured regress argument distinguishing real deliberation from the stronger ultimate-source condition for basic desert.

newArguments.title: Rights-respecting quarantine model
newArguments.text: A nonretributive system can distinguish offender from innocent person through evidence, causal responsibility for harm, due process, proportional risk management, and strict rights against instrumental sacrifice. The justification resembles quarantine: restriction may be permissible to prevent serious harm, but imposed suffering is not valuable because anyone deserves pain. This answers the framing objection without appealing to ultimate desert, since framing lacks causal responsibility, violates rights, corrupts institutions, and predictably increases insecurity while offering no legitimate individualized basis for restraint.

novelty.explanation: This is a new institutional framework answering the innocent-framing problem through causal responsibility, rights, and due process.
